notes: NFC sticker of the partner package, shown as a mock-up on the slide 'Partner pakket'. REAL SIZE IS A PROPOSAL: the disc measures 24.8 mm on the slide (horizontal 254.68 to 279.49 mm, vertical 24.7 mm), 69.3 mm at the scale 0.358, proposed 70 mm round (trim 70 x 70, 3 mm bleed, the reference is scaled so that 70 mm equals the measured disc, 1 percent). REBUILT: in the source the grey sticker body and its shadow are one raster image; the disc is a flat vector circle (#E1E1E1, no token) and the raster is not used. Only the beeldmerk and the text are vector in the source. Library: py-atom-logo-beeldmerk-color (compared: same drawing, 26.6 mm wide, 32.1 mm high, centred, top 24.2 mm above the centre). Text: 'Reserveer je' / 'parkeerplek' is outlined in the source; fitted by overlay as Ubuntu Bold 6.68 mm (ink width 39.3 and 38.3 mm, ink height agrees), navy, centred, baseline pitch about 7.7 mm; live text in the template. NFC chip: its type and position are NOT drawn (unknown); keep a chip free zone (to be defined by the supplier) before the artwork is sent to print. Cut contour: circle with radius half the diameter, 0.2 mm inside the trim, 1 pt ThruCut: proposal. Colours: slide blue #192AA2 and cyan #0AD3E6 are drift, the template uses #1A3580 and #32B9CD (inside the beeldmerk). Variables: line-1, line-2.
